source_title: Little boy's Apsara Aali dance performance has internet calling him 'new-age Natraj' - India Today
source_excerpt:
A little boy's graceful performance to Marathi hit Apsara Aali has impressed viewers, with his fluid moves and expressive dance leaving onlookers cheering him on.
A little boy was seen dancing gracefully to the Marathi hit Apsara Aali , nailing the song’s signature moves with fluid steps and expressions that seemed perfectly in sync with the music.
Instagram user Divya Mane shared the video, capturing the young dancer’s performance as he effortlessly moved to the popular Lavani number, drawing the attention of everyone around him.
In the video, the boy appeared completely immersed in the music, moving with a confidence that belied his age. His steps were smooth and expressive, while his facial expressions added an extra layer of charm to the performance.
Whether it was the way he matched the rhythm or the ease with which he transitioned between moves, he seemed to know exactly how to bring the song to life.
He soon had an audience. Children and adults in the background paused to watch him dance, with several clapping and cheering him on. Some even tried to copy his steps and join in, turning his solo performance into a little dance party of its own.
Apsara Aali , from the 2013 Marathi film Natarang , is a popular Lavani song featuring actress Sonalee Kulkarni. Sung by Bela Shende, with music by Ajay-Atul, the track is known for its energetic rhythm and traditional Maharashtrian dance style.
Sharing the clip, Divya captioned it, “Art is in the blood that is a boy.”
Watch the video here : The video garnered admiration from viewers, with one user predicting that the little dancer could be the next generation of “NATRAJ”. Another appreciated the lack of judgement from those watching a boy perform, while a third pointed out how children are celebrated for expressing themselves when they are young but may face criticism for the same art as they grow older. - Ends
